command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== chrT 12 kb; one gene, 3 exons, canonical GT..AG introns =="
awk 'BEGIN{srand(41); b="ACGT"; s=""
  for(i=0;i<12000;i++) s=s substr(b,int(rand()*4)+1,1)
  s = substr(s,1,1300) "GT" substr(s,1303,1196) "AG" substr(s,2501)
  s = substr(s,1,2700) "GT" substr(s,2703,1296) "AG" substr(s,4001)
  print ">chrT"; for(i=1;i<=length(s);i+=60) print substr(s,i,60) }' > genome.fa
G=$(awk '!/^>/{printf "%s",$0}' genome.fa)
test "${#G}"       = 12000 || { echo "FIXTURE: genome is ${#G} bp"; exit 1; }
test "${G:1300:2}" = GT    || { echo "FIXTURE: intron1 donor is not GT"; exit 1; }
test "${G:2498:2}" = AG    || { echo "FIXTURE: intron1 acceptor is not AG"; exit 1; }
test "${G:2700:2}" = GT    || { echo "FIXTURE: intron2 donor is not GT"; exit 1; }
test "${G:3998:2}" = AG    || { echo "FIXTURE: intron2 acceptor is not AG"; exit 1; }
E1="${G:1000:300}"; E2="${G:2500:200}"; E3="${G:4000:400}"
MRNA="$E1$E2$E3"
test "${#MRNA}" = 900 || { echo "FIXTURE: mRNA is ${#MRNA} bp"; exit 1; }
{ printf 'fixture_gene\texons 1001-1300 / 2501-2700 / 4001-4400 = 900 bp mRNA\n'
  printf 'fixture_splice\tintrons 1301-2500 and 2701-4000, both canonical GT..AG\n'; } | tee fixture.txt

echo "== the planted annotation, and the introns it implies =="
{ printf 'chrT\tplanted\texon\t1001\t1300\t.\t+\t.\tgene_id "G1"; transcript_id "G1.1";\n'
  printf 'chrT\tplanted\texon\t2501\t2700\t.\t+\t.\tgene_id "G1"; transcript_id "G1.1";\n'
  printf 'chrT\tplanted\texon\t4001\t4400\t.\t+\t.\tgene_id "G1"; transcript_id "G1.1";\n'; } > truth.gtf
printf '1301\t2500\n2701\t4000\n' > truth_introns.tsv
printf '1001\t1300\n2501\t2700\n4001\t4400\n' > truth_exons.tsv

echo "== 100 bp reads FROM THE mRNA, so mapping them to the genome requires splicing =="
awk -v m="$MRNA" 'BEGIN{ RL=100; q=""; for(i=0;i<RL;i++) q=q "I"; n=0
  for(p=1;p+RL-1<=length(m);p+=3){ n++; printf "@t%d\n%s\n+\n%s\n", n, substr(m,p,RL), q > "reads.fq" }
  p=length(m)-RL+1; n++; printf "@t%d\n%s\n+\n%s\n", n, substr(m,p,RL), q > "reads.fq"
  printf "fixture_reads\t%d reads / %.1fx over the mRNA\n", n, n*RL/length(m) }' | tee -a fixture.txt

echo "== hisat2: spliced alignment, with NO annotation supplied =="
hisat2-build -p 2 genome.fa idx > hisat2build.log 2>&1
hisat2 -p 2 -x idx -U reads.fq -S aln.sam --rg-id s1 --rg SM:sample1 2> hisat2.log
cat hisat2.log
RATE=$(sed -n 's/^\([0-9.]*\)% overall alignment rate/\1/p' hisat2.log)
NSPL=$(awk '!/^@/ && $6 ~ /N/ {n++} END{print n+0}' aln.sam)
test "$NSPL" -gt 0 || { echo "no spliced alignment -- hisat2 did not cross a junction"; exit 1; }

echo "== the introns hisat2 actually found, read off the CIGARs =="
awk '!/^@/ && $6 ~ /N/ { g=$4; c=$6
  while (match(c,/^[0-9]+[MIDNSHP=X]/)) { L=substr(c,1,RLENGTH-1)+0; O=substr(c,RLENGTH,1)
    if (O=="N") print g"\t"(g+L-1)
    if (O=="M"||O=="D"||O=="N"||O=="="||O=="X") g+=L
    c=substr(c,RLENGTH+1) } }' aln.sam | sort -u > found_introns.tsv
cat found_introns.tsv
diff -q truth_introns.tsv found_introns.tsv > /dev/null \
  || { echo "hisat2's introns are not the planted ones:"; diff truth_introns.tsv found_introns.tsv; exit 1; }
{ printf 'alignment_rate\t%s%%\n' "$RATE"
  printf 'spliced_alignments\t%s   (assert >0)\n' "$NSPL"
  printf 'hisat2_introns_exact\tyes   (assert yes -- EXACT: the junctions hisat2 found ARE the planted ones)\n'; } | tee -a fixture.txt
echo "ALIGN OK"
